《饿殍：明末千里行》X《飞越13号房》捆绑包今日上架。9月14日-28日《飞越13号房》享-42%史低折扣，购买捆绑包额外享10%折上折！

notes.title: Launching "Misunderstood Youth" Healing Project
notes.content:
The "Misunderstood Youth" Healing Project is now officially underway! It's been half a year since "Beyond Room 13" launched, and our message board is flooded with over 3,000 authentic stories - a number that grows daily. Many of you have courageously shared tales of youthful days where your passions and pursuits were dismissed by the world, of being isolated and suppressed in school, or being ensnared by past traumas. We're here, and we embrace each one of you.

We've come to recognize that in the unseen corners, numerous "daring souls" walk their paths alone. In the coming days, we will roll out a series of initiatives using illustrations, videos, livestreams, and more to listen to your stories. We're also bringing on board empathetic professionals to offer guidance and answers to your burning questions.

Dive into the "Misunderstood Youth" Healing Project →[url=[url=https://www.altlab.cn/benefit/index.html]]here.[/url]
Celebrities Zhang Yang, Cui Nannan, Jiang Hongwen, Qi Miao, and Xu Shanwa have also shared their "Misunderstood Youth" stories.→[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1q44y1c7Rj/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=4da464c9e8ea6742707aa83c131b726a]Video[/url]

Seeking Your Concerns
If you have your own concerns and confusions, click →[url=https://wj.qq.com/s2/12743538/e443]Question Collection[/url] to share them. Whether it's miscommunications with parents or friends, or deep-seated pains that seem impossible to heal, if it's weighing you down, we want to hear it. We'll bring in psychologists and special guests to address your concerns.
Remember, no one is truly alone. There's always a ray of light, a corner filled with warmth and compassion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/08e58563a2d57dbb3fcd2cc993d0ea5b77ed8791.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Original animation work launched, adapted from real-life experiences of players
notes.content:
An original animation work is launched, adapted from real-life experiences of players in 'World Message Board'. 
Today, we are sharing a unique message from the World Message Board. His story, similar to the main character Zhang Yang's tale in Room 13, carries a startling reality. We were touched by the past and present of these firsthand witnesses, and recommended them as interviewees for the channel 'Extraordinary Human Documentaries' to share their 'extraordinary' story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/2ecbe49989398c967c933545098a243037e7fd83.jpg[/img]

Click here for the complete animation: '[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1mk4y1M7Qg/?spm_id_from=333.999.0.0&vd_source=10c1261e6742f782833122ed3ef88612]That New Year's Eve, I Escaped from the Fraudulent Internet Detox Centre[/url]'. 

There are still many firsthand witnesses on the World Message Board pouring out their indignation to strangers. Page by page, we can feel the damage this has caused to them. The extraordinary individuals, some have left their past behind and started a new life, some still embrace their past selves in trepidation, and many more have stepped forward with a desire to provide help and change. These positive messages have given us great encouragement. Our power is very limited, but we are very honored that the 'Breakout 13' World Message Board can be a medium for the firsthand witnesses to voice out, get embraced and cared for, and also a vent for their emotions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/bdf2f36ab241874650d092c37d91c3d2e626fdd4.jpg[/img]

We are very grateful to 'Extraordinary Human Documentaries' for digging into and producing the message story, allowing more people to focus on this topic again. The real-life fireworks have not arrived yet, we will look forward to it with everyone!

notes.title: Breakout 13 is screening in Cannes this year
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/4453b7aa4c5ddd25cdd648c81167570cfe738ba9.jpg[/img]

Breakout 13 will be screening during this year's Cannes Film Festival, at Marché du Film NEXT section.

The 'Cannes NEXT' demonstrate the most representative direction of global film industry development and future possibilities in the past year. A variety of renowned VR films and advanced images have been shown here. "Breakout 13" has been selected as the only interactive image work among the five works most representative of the "future image development innovation". During the Cannes NEXT screening, this work was commended as "an innovative and socially impactful interactive film, seamlessly integrating film style and groundbreaking interactive storytelling". We are very excited!

We will continue to strive to introduce better works and delve deeply into the field of interactive storytelling works in the future!

notes.title: The Part II "Fight" is now officially on sale!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095300/13/?beta=0
Dear fellow gamer friends,

Hello! The second half of "Breakout 13" - "Fight" - will officially go on sale at 4 pm today. Thank you all for your patience and support! "Fight" includes chapters 6 to the end.

Since the start of the game's development, it has been almost three years, with many twists and turns. The tremendous pressure from the game's unique theme has also driven us to work without slacking off. During these uncertain years, we have been immersed in creating and have repeatedly reviewed and revised our work to not lose sight of our original intent. We are very excited and anxious to finally present it to you today!

In the future, we will continue to optimize the product. Once again, we thank you all for your companionship and support. We cherish and consider every suggestion you provide, and work hard to find solutions for each problem. Every compliment makes us feel that our efforts and perseverance have been acknowledged.

The road ahead may be bumpy, but being able to be with you all, there will always be light in our hearts.

ALT Lab Studio

notes.title: 下半部 :《反击》篇定档公告
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095300/13/
各位学员大家好：

《飞越13号房》下半部《反击》篇将于[b]2月2日[/b]发售，《反击》篇定价32元，抱歉让大家久等了！

自上线以来，《飞越13号房》受到了大家的关注和支持，我们诚惶诚恐。同时，我们看到玩家在评论中的催促，对于玩家最关切的下半部《反击》篇发布信息的相关问题，我们不敢有一丝怠慢。

疫情感染全面爆发正好在上线日1月9日的前几周，意外全员感染导致开发团队持续减员，但因为我们已经在11月提前公布了定档1月9日的消息，这个意外打乱了我们原本的计划，也耽误了数周工期，因此我们被迫将已经完成的部分按时上线。但这个也导致了一些衍生问题，我们此刻正在加紧解决。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/005ae8d83e47280f324845fce402c5528c7e319f.jpg[/img]

ALT Lab是一个年轻团队，这是我们第一次在Steam发布产品，我们还有很多经验不足的地方，希望大家谅解与继续支持。

我们会专注做好下半部的开发和优化，希望过去两年的努力能够不负初心！

最后，信息已收到，我们搞快点！


ALT LAB 工作室

notes.title: The breakout demo is available now!
notes.content:
In the breakout, you play as a student in Gratitude international education centre and try to escape.  
It provides about 60 mins play experience including QTE, branching and hidden objects. Welcome all come to play it. We are also glad you added our games to the wishlist so you can get information about the game at the first time. We hope you enjoy the demo and please do let us know your thoughts in the comments section if you want, it can help us improve our game, and become better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/5b6e96cbd8943a3fb13974130c81ff54b1f5894b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo will be issued on September 23rd
notes.content:
Hello, students! Here is a notification: 
We know you all expect the Breakout demo. We can finally release the publish date of the demo, it will be available on Steam, September 23  for free!
As a freshman, what kind of welcome ceremony will the headmaster Yang hold for you?
Shhh -- no worry, on September 23rd, you'll find out by yourself.

notes.title: Breakout demo will be out this month
notes.content:
Thank you, students, for your expectation and support for Breakout during this time.

Breakout will release a free demo for everyone this month. It provides chapter 0 content, about 30 mins game experience.

For now, our development team is still working hard to improve the game Breakout. The specific release date will be published first when we complete the game.

We are also glad you added our games to your wishlist so that you can get information about the game at the first time. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/9bc05e4cc37e3500c941ffc7aae597e5ff9e8072.png[/img]

notes.title: Nice to meet you guys!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42704463/40863b4d7cfc892910737591bb663ebda3be4d7c.png[/img]
Welcome! New students of Room 13!
Thank you for your interest for “Breakout”! During the period before officially on sale, we will take all of your support and encouragement to polish our work more carefully.
Also you are welcome to add Breakout to your wishlist and receive the latest news of the product!
Thank you again for your support. Let’s look forward to the official launch of “Breakout!
